body.name: Value-matching dependency graph \(D_{T}\)
body.construction: For a labelled source factor \(T\), let \(D_T\) have vertex set \(T\) and arc \(u\to v\) exactly when \(u\to v\) is directed in \(G\) and the value carried by the source literal for \(u\) equals the value requested for \(u\) in the parent subscript of \(v\); on \(U\subseteq T\), use the induced digraph \(D_T[U]\).
